caption:
Halloween's over. Your dark pages don't have to be. 🖤

Four from the book: a ghoul in front of her mansion, a skeleton climbing out by a stone tower, a skeletal lady in her gown, and a crooked old house in the woods. Which one are you coloring first, 1, 2, 3 or 4?

The book has 200 grimdark horror pages in deeply detailed line art. Print-ready PDF plus 300 DPI PNG files, A4 / 8.5 x 11 in.
